learn.title: Guided projects
learn.intro: Build a working robot step by step. Each step checks your circuit and code as you go and tells you what to fix.

learn.replaceTitle: Replace the project in this browser?
learn.replaceBody: Starting a guided project replaces the project you have open in this browser. Download it first if you want to keep it, or sign in to keep projects in your account.

complete.title: You built it!
complete.body: Every step is done and your robot met the challenge. Your progress is saved.
